TL;DR

We believe that this decision was necessary in order to avoid potential problems with the project and to improve its quality by providing smoother data.

Proposal description

We recently completed the ABC Advanced page project, and it is now live. During the course of the project, we ended up spending more money than originally planned. We requested 5,000 WXDAI, but ended up spending 6580 WXDAI. Some of these additional funds came from the transparency multisig, but 759 WXDAI came from my personal funds.

We encountered some issues with the dune v1 deployment, which would have resulted in data being broken past December if we did not migrate and pay for the dune API. Since this was outside of our original budget, we decided to go ahead and use the graph for the deployment instead. This not only solved the problem with the dune v1 deployment, but it also improved the product by providing smoother data.

Overall, we made the decision to spend additional funds in order to avoid potential problems with the project after its launch, and we believe this was the right decision to ensure the success of the project.

We believe that providing a visual representation of the bonding curve will greatly enhance the user experience when interacting with it. Before the Advanced page deployment, the bonding curve was looking like a simple swap without much context for the user. Our designs for a visual representation of the bonding curve help users better understand what is happening when they interact with it.
